about_the_game:
Build Your Home on a Living Beast. Fight, Craft, and Grow.

Notmads is a fast-paced open-world action RPG built around deep progression, powerful magic, and a nomadic fortress that evolves with you.

Play solo or online co-op (up to 5 players) in a shared world — sharing the same beast.

A Living Beast That Grows With You

This is not a mount.

This is not a pet.

This is a living companion — and the foundation of your journey.

  • Raise and bond with a rare walking beast

  • Watch it evolve through different stages of life

  • Build directly on its back as your mobile home expands

  • Unlock new abilities and structural expansions as it matures

Your home moves. Your world expands.

Build for Power, Not Just Appearance

Build for style, build for function, or build for survival.

  • Customizable building pieces and visual styles

  • Place functional stations and utilities inside your base

  • Automate and upgrade building stations for smoother progression

  • Add defenses like towers to protect what you’ve built

  • Expand your setup as new tiers and materials unlock

This isn’t decoration — your base is part of your power.

Magical Beam Resource Gathering (With Its Own Progression)

As a mage, you don’t gather like everyone else.

Focus raw energy into a controlled Magical Beam and reshape how you harvest and progress.

  • Use the Magical Beam as your primary resource gathering tool

  • Level it up independently from your character

  • Unlock upgrades through its own perk tree

  • Increase efficiency, unlock new capabilities, and scale into higher tiers

Gather faster. Unlock more. Scale into higher tiers.

Fast-Paced Action RPG Combat

Combat is responsive, aggressive, and built around meaningful build choices.

Fight with spells and weapons that scale through powerful progression spikes.

Combine elemental abilities and adapt to different enemy threats.

  • Fast-paced ARPG-style action

  • Fight with spells, weapons, and progression-driven power spikes

  • Adapt to threats with different tools and tactics

  • Face hostile forces and dangerous encounters across the world

Spells, Tiers, and Elemental Disciplines

Magic is a system — not just a visual effect.

  • Many magical spells across multiple tiers

  • Unlock stronger versions as you progress

Specialize into distinct disciplines:

  • Vigour — Strength, resilience, physical dominance

  • Wizardry — Raw arcane mastery

  • Pyromancy — Destructive fire magic

  • Cryomancy — Frost control and battlefield pressure

  • Electromancy — Lightning speed and precision

Your build defines your playstyle — and your role in co-op.

Level Up and Progress Through Deep Trees

Grow in multiple directions — character power, magic, gathering, and your nomadic base.

  • Level up and become dramatically stronger over time

  • Unlock perks and upgrades that change how you play

  • Progress through multiple systems that evolve together

Every upgrade matters.

Explore a Living Open World

Travel through towns, wilderness, caves, camps, and hidden locations — always hunting for the next upgrade, the next material tier, and the next challenge.

  • Open-world exploration

  • Quests and progression-driven objectives

  • Combat encounters and escalating challenges

  • Resources and secrets scattered across the world

Play Solo or Online Co-op (1–5 Players)

Notmads can be experienced alone or with friends.

  • Online co-op for up to 5 players

  • Share the same living beast

  • Build, explore, and fight together

  • Progress together in a shared, persistent world

Whether alone or together, the journey evolves with you.

You are not settling.

You are becoming nomadic.

name: Notmads

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB / AMD RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended

short_description: Command a living beast as a mage in a fast-paced open-world action RPG — gather, craft, and build your fortress on its back, master powerful spells, and play solo or online co-op for up to 5 players.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Catalan
*languages with full audio support
